input-field.name: tokenMonitoring
input-field.label: Monitoring Token
Monitoring-Token
input-field.helpText: Bearer token for /health/* endpoints (CANARY_TOKEN_MONITORING). Leave blank to use the environment variable.

input-field.name: tokenCache
input-field.label: Cache Token
Cache-Token
input-field.helpText: Bearer token for /cache/* endpoints (CANARY_TOKEN_CACHE). Leave blank to use the environment variable.

input-field.name: tokenDeploy
input-field.label: Deploy Token
Deploy-Token
input-field.helpText: Bearer token for /deploy/* endpoints (CANARY_TOKEN_DEPLOY). Leave blank to use the environment variable.

input-field.name: tokenDiagnostics
input-field.label: Diagnostics Token
Diagnose-Token
input-field.helpText: Bearer token for /diag/* endpoints (CANARY_TOKEN_DIAGNOSTICS). Leave blank to use the environment variable.

input-field.name: tokenAdmin
input-field.label: Admin Token
Admin-Token
input-field.helpText: Bearer token with access to all scopes (CANARY_TOKEN_ADMIN). Leave blank to use the environment variable.

input-field.name: allowedCidrs
input-field.label: Allowed IP Ranges
Erlaubte IP-Bereiche
input-field.helpText: Comma-separated CIDR ranges allowed to call Canary endpoints (CANARY_ALLOWED_CIDRS). Leave blank to allow all IPs.

input-field.name: maintenanceReason
input-field.label: Default Maintenance Reason
Standard-Wartungsgrund
input-field.helpText: Default reason shown when maintenance mode is enabled without an explicit reason in the API request body. Stored as YorvoLabsCanary.config.maintenanceReason.

input-field.name: queueThreshold
input-field.label: Queue Depth Threshold
Warteschlangentiefe-Schwellenwert
input-field.helpText: Pre-deploy check fails when pending messages exceed this value (CANARY_DEPLOY_QUEUE_THRESHOLD, default 100).

input-field.name: failedThreshold
input-field.label: Failed Messages Threshold
Fehlgeschlagene-Nachrichten-Schwellenwert
input-field.helpText: Pre-deploy check fails when dead-letter count exceeds this value (CANARY_DEPLOY_FAILED_THRESHOLD, default 0).

input-field.name: rateLimitHealth
input-field.label: Health Endpoint Rate Limit (requests/min)
Health-Endpunkt Ratenlimit (Anfragen/Min)
input-field.helpText: Maximum requests per minute for /health/* endpoints (CANARY_RATE_LIMIT_HEALTH, default 60).

input-field.name: rateLimitMutation
input-field.label: Mutation Endpoint Rate Limit (requests/min)
Mutations-Endpunkt Ratenlimit (Anfragen/Min)
input-field.helpText: Maximum requests per minute for cache-clearing and deploy endpoints (CANARY_RATE_LIMIT_MUTATION, default 10).
